_comment: Canopy repo-local Codex hooks. `canopy init` writes this to <repo>/.codex/hooks.json unless one already exists. Commands no-op unless Canopy is initialized and the packaged hook scripts exist under ~/.codex/canopy/hooks/.

hooks.command: bash -lc 'payload=$(cat 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$payload" ] || exit 0; [ -f ./.canopy/state.json ] || exit 0; [ -x "$HOME/.codex/canopy/hooks/guard-project-write.sh" ] || exit 0; printf "%s" "$payload" | "$HOME/.codex/canopy/hooks/guard-project-write.sh"'

bash -lc 'payload=$(cat 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$payload" ] || exit 0; [ -f ./.canopy/state.json ] || exit 0; [ -x "$HOME/.codex/canopy/hooks/guard-pr-create.sh" ] || exit 0; printf "%s" "$payload" | "$HOME/.codex/canopy/hooks/guard-pr-create.sh"'
